Purchase to receipt

Buy raw materials on a purchase order and receive them into a warehouse.

Walked in LN, Aug 2026
Procurement
Warehousing

Before you start. Know the item's stock before you start: Check an item's inventory. The materials exist as items with purchase defaults, and the receiving warehouse exists. Create test items phases 2 and 5 build both. A buy-from business partner must also exist — this walkthrough selects one, it does not create one.

Start6 tasks · 27 steps

The tasks, in order

  1. 1Read the baselineOn-hand at the receiving warehouse is recorded before anything is booked · 4 steps
  2. 2Create the purchase orderAn order exists against a buy-from business partner · 5 steps
  3. 3Book the linesEach material is ordered in the right quantity, to the right warehouse · 5 steps
  4. 4Receive against the orderLN's generated inbound order is found and receiving is started · 4 steps
  5. 5Confirm the receiptThe receipt reaches Confirmed with all lines final and complete · 6 steps
  6. 6Verify the inventory increaseOn-hand rose by exactly the quantity received · 3 steps
    • Create the purchase orderOrder type is not IPO

      Nothing. IPO is what this environment defaulted on one dated run, not a required value

    • Receive against the orderNo warehousing order appears after saving the purchase order

      The warehouse on the order lines (Book the lines, step 4). Without one, there is nothing for LN to raise an inbound order against. Then the purchase order's Release to Warehousing tab: a line still sitting there has not been released, and Purchase Order Line Status tdpur4534m000 names the activity it is waiting on

    • Receive against the orderThe Actions menu offers no receive command

      The order origin. An outbound order carries outbound activities; confirm you opened the generated inbound order from Receive against the order, step 1, not the purchase order

    • Confirm the receiptwhinh0032 at the receipt

      The message names missing stock point details for the receipt line. Capture the LOG detail before clearing it — and afterwards, read the receipt's Errors Logged flag and Receipt Message Log whinh3530m000, which hold the messages once the dialog is gone

    • Confirm the receiptThe receipt looks confirmed but nothing was received

      Whether the receipt has any lines at all. whinh3512m000's help states Confirmed is cleared when the receipt has no receipt lines — the same cleared box as a receipt whose lines are merely unconfirmed

    • Verify the inventory increaseThe receipt confirms but on-hand does not move

      Whether All Lines Final and All Lines Complete were both set (Confirm the receipt, step 4), and whether the receiving warehouse in Verify the inventory increase is the one from Read the baseline, step 1

    • Purchase with inspection

      An inspection activity sits between receipt and put-away. Warehouse Inspections whinh3122m000 runs against a receipt in this environment. This adds a phase and would earn its own walkthrough.

    • Direct-delivery purchase

      Goods ship from the supplier to a customer without entering your warehouse. That removes phases 3–5 entirely, so it is a different process, not a variant of this one

    • Booking opening stock instead of buying

      The adjustment route the notes of Create test items Stock the components describe — a cycle counting/adjustment order. Faster, but it bypasses purchase defaults and leaves no purchase price history. Its entry session was never captured

    • The raw materials are on hand at the receiving warehouse

      Production order — consume them into a build

    • The materials are on hand but in the wrong warehouse

      Warehouse transfer
